name: forge-workspace
title: Forge Workspace
description: Workspace chrome: header, undo/redo toolbar, docks, floating panels, status line. Needs StudioUIProvider, @nyc-tron controls, studio-layout.

a11yFailures: N01 1.4.3: light muted #687287 on base 4.43:1 for 9 to 11 pt header, status and rail text (index.tsx:190,196)
N07 4.1.3: status line uses accessibilityLiveRegion, Android and web only; iOS silent (index.tsx:273)

prerequisites.reason: Private workspace package with no tarball. Distribution waits on the versioning scheme (decision 3).

docs:
Needs @nitro-forge/studio-ui-provider (StudioUIProvider) and a host such as nyc-tron-host. Every studio component throws without it. See docs/agent-native/install-order.md step 7.
Needs @nitro-forge/studio-layout first (step 3 of docs/agent-native/install-order.md). shadcn cannot install it.
